facts.statement: Times Higher Education (THE) World University Rankings 2027 places SR University in the 801–1000 band globally and 7th among private universities in India (also 801–1000 in the 2026 edition). THE ranks SR University #6 in India in Research Quality.
facts.source: Times Higher Education World University Rankings 2027 as printed on the SR University Official Fee Structure & Merit Scholarship fee card 2027-28 (rankings section); THE profile page (801–1000 in 2026 and 2027); Research Quality from the admissions presentation, 30 Oct 2026

facts.statement: SR University is established under the Telangana State Private Universities Act 2018, recognised under UGC Section 2(f), and holds NBA Tier-I accreditation for its UG engineering programmes (B.Tech CSE, ECE, EEE, ME and CE).
facts.source: Telangana State Gazette Act No. 13 of 2018, UGC 2(f) notification; NBA scope from SR University admissions presentation, 30 Oct 2026 (data/handbook/10_admissions_presentation_oct2026.md)

metadata.short: **NBA Tier-I** accredited B.Tech (CSE, ECE, EEE, ME, CE); UGC 2(f) recognised under the TS Private Universities Act 2018

facts.statement: SR University maintains a 6 to 6.5 LPA average package across engineering disciplines, with top offers reaching ₹51 LPA (Microsoft, Batch 2025), ₹49.30 LPA (ServiceNow, Batch 2027), and ₹46.38 LPA (Amazon, Batch 2026).
facts.source: Center for Student Services and Placements (CSSP) Official Placement Audit 2025-2027

metadata.short: **Placements:** highest **₹51 LPA (Microsoft)** and **₹46.38 LPA (Amazon)**; 1,300+ offers from 150+ recruiters

facts.statement: SR University provides 100% placement assistance and rigorous interview/coding preparation through the Center for Student Services and Placements (CSSP) and Career Guidance Cell (CGC). Individual job offers depend on student interview performance and skill clearance; offers are never blindly guaranteed.
facts.source: CSSP Placement Regulations Charter 2027-28

metadata.short: **Career support:** 100% placement assistance — training, mock interviews and internships through CSSP

facts.statement: SR Innovation Exchange (SRiX) is a DST-supported Technology Business Incubator hosting 171+ startups, ₹76+ Cr in funding, 14+ maker spaces, an IoT & ESDM lab, and a 3D rapid prototyping facility.
facts.source: Department of Science and Technology (DST) & SRiX Annual Report

metadata.short: **SRiX incubator** (DST-supported): **171+ startups**, ₹76+ Cr raised, maker spaces and prototyping labs

facts.statement: SR University hosts 11 interdisciplinary research centers, 14+ maker spaces at SRiX, and dedicated departmental teaching laboratories across all 6 specialized schools on its 170-acre campus.
facts.source: Academic Affairs & Dean of Engineering Infrastructure Directory 2027-28

metadata.short: **Labs:** 11 interdisciplinary research centres and 14+ maker spaces across 6 schools

facts.statement: Hostel in-time is strictly 8:30 PM for first-year residential students (with biometric roll call). For senior students, in-time is 9:00 PM on weekdays and 9:30 PM on weekends. Campus operates 24/7 security, wardens, CCTV, and an on-campus health dispensary.
facts.source: Office of Chief Warden, Student Residential Handbook 2027-28

facts.statement: Hostels offer 3-sharing and 4-sharing AC and Non-AC rooms (ranging from ₹1,15,000 to ₹1,35,000/year). All hostel packages include 4 nutritious daily meals in the 4,000-seat Mega Dining Hall, Wi-Fi, laundry, and round-the-clock maintenance.
facts.source: Admissions & Hostel Fee Circular 2027-28

facts.statement: For academic session 2027-28, B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering (CSE) tuition is ₹3,40,000 per year (₹1,70,000 per semester), plus ₹5,000 one-time enrollment, ₹15,000/yr other academic charges, and ₹5,000/yr examination fee. An annual ₹9,000 escalation applies to tuition in future academic years.
facts.source: Admissions Office Fee Circular 2027-28 (Ref: SRU/ADM/2026/FEE-01)

facts.statement: For academic session 2027-28, B.Tech Artificial Intelligence & Robotics tuition is ₹4,00,000 per year (₹2,00,000 per semester). Merit scholarships up to 40% apply.
facts.source: Admissions Office Fee Circular 2027-28

facts.statement: SR University awards merit scholarships of 10% to 40% tuition fee waiver based on 10+2 Intermediate board percentage (95%+ / 985+ marks: 40%; 80%+: 25%; 70%+: 20%; 60%+: 10%), JEE Main percentile, or TG/AP EAPCET rank.
facts.source: SRU Merit Scholarship Scheme 2027-28

facts.statement: SR University provides 19 special-category fee concessions ranging from ₹15,000 to ₹50,000 per year (for orphans, sports champions, staff children, single parent, defence ward, sibling at SRU, AP residents, girl child non-TS).
facts.source: Special Category Concession Circular 2027-28

facts.statement: B.Tech minimum marks differ between official sources: the 2027-28 fee card lists standard fees from 50% in 10+2 / Intermediate with MPC (CSE and ECE fees from 55%), while the 2026-27 B.Tech programme pages list 60% in 10+2 PCM. Until the Admissions Office confirms the 2027-28 minimum, scores in between are reported as needing confirmation; below 50% does not meet any listed minimum. Admission is merit-based, subject to seat availability and certificate verification. SR University never guarantees or reserves seats unconditionally for any score.
facts.source: 2027-28 fee card and sru.edu.in B.Tech programme pages (2026-27); conflict recorded in fees_2027_28.json

facts.statement: Placement Leadership at SR University is headed by Mr. D. Sridhar (Head CSSP, stu.cssp@sru.edu.in) and Mr. G. Sunil (Placement Operations, SRiX 1st Floor).
facts.source: Administrative Directory 2027-28

facts.statement: Admissions & Fee Enquiries: 833 100 3030 (info@sru.edu.in). Campus Visit Planning Helpline: 833 100 4040 (sru.edu.in/visit-us).
